zh.title: Montana 120th Airlift Wing轉換至C-130J-30 退役C-130H去向包括儲存、訓練與海外服役
zh.summary: Montana 120th Airlift Wing轉換至C-130J-30，退役C-130H去向包括儲存、訓練與海外服役
body: Simple Flying報導摘要指出，Montana 120th Airlift Wing正轉換至C-130J-30。摘要將這項機隊變動描述為進行中，未稱轉換已完成；目前可報導的狀態是正在轉換，而非已完成更換。
摘要指出，退役C-130H面臨儲存、訓練或海外服役等去向。這些是摘要列出的可能方向，並未將其中一項說成所有退役飛機的確定安排；因此目前可確認的是這些去向均被提及。

en.title: Montana's 120th Airlift Wing Transitions to C-130J-30
en.summary: Montana’s 120th Airlift Wing is transitioning to C-130J-30; retired C-130Hs face storage, training or overseas service.
body: Simple Flying’s report summary says Montana’s 120th Airlift Wing is transitioning to the C-130J-30. The change is described as underway, not as a completed transition, so the available information supports describing it as an ongoing change.

The summary says retired C-130Hs face new futures in storage, training or overseas service. It lists these as possible directions rather than identifying one as the outcome for every aircraft. The available information does not establish a single disposition for the retired aircraft.
